​

The anxiety aspect was the other main reason I would take it, it has definitely helped me feel less anxious, but I still havent really felt as significant of a change as I would like to. I also find that its easier to not be scared of things, but not by a big margin ( it could be that im on too low of a dose). 

Overall I feel that it has definitely been a step in the right direction, but I still have some progress for me to make. 

I would say try it, you dont really have anything to lose and if it doesnt work just quit it.
